scalars.scalar_value: Recent college-level teaching experience in Culinary Arts, Baking & Pastry, Hospitality, Food Service Management, or a closely related discipline, with at least 5 years of kitchen supervision of 30 personnel.

items.item_text: 01. Select the career website you used to find this employment opportunity: Options: Sbccd.edu | Indeed.com | HigherEdJobs.com | EdJoin.org | CCCregistry.org | Other
02. Did you attach the required transcripts? Options: Yes | No

03. Which option below best describes your highest level of education? (NOTE: For positions requiring college units/degree, a copy of the transcript must be included as an attachment. The transcript must be legible from an accredited institution and include your name, the institution name and confer date). Options: Some High School | High School or G.E.D. | Some College | Associates Degree | Bachelors Degree | Masters Degree | Doctorate Degree | None

04. Please describe your college-level teaching experience in Culinary Arts, Baking & Pastry, Hospitality, Food Service Management, or a closely related discipline, including at least 5 years of kitchen supervision of 30 personnel. Please include length of time.

05. Please describe your experience teaching in face-to-face, hybrid, and online learning environments, with the ability to adapt instruction to diverse delivery methods and assessing student knowledge and practical skills, and using assessment results to improve teaching and learning outcomes.

06. Please explain your experience using the Canvas Learning Management System (LMS) or a similar system for course management, communication, grading, assessment, student engagement and demonstrated use of effective instructional practices, including hands-on learning, active learning strategies, and technology-enhanced teaching methods. Please include lengths of time using these systems.

07. Please describe your current industry experience in culinary arts, baking and pastry, hospitality, foodservice, catering, or a related field that supports workforce-relevant instruction that spans local/regional/international cuisine.
08. Please describe how you demonstrate strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, collaborate effectively with students, faculty, staff, and industry partners.
09. Do you Possess an American Culinary Federation Certification?
10. Do you possess a ServSafe Certification?

11. I hereby understand and declare that the statements on this supplemental questionnaire are true and complete to the best of my knowledge. As applicable, I hereby authorize the District and/or designees to contact the references listed to verify the information I have supplied. I hereby release from liability all persons and organizations furnishing such information. I understand that the District reserves the right to validate information received on the supplemental questionnaire and that I will be subject to disqualification and/or termination if any statement in this supplemental questionnaire is found to be untrue or determined to be misleading. Options: Yes | No
Possess an American Culinary Federation Certification

Recent college-level teaching experience in Culinary Arts, Baking & Pastry, Hospitality, Food Service Management, or a closely related discipline, with at least 5 years of kitchen supervision of 30 personnel.

Experience teaching in face-to-face, hybrid, and online learning environments, with the ability to adapt instruction to diverse delivery methods and assessing student knowledge and practical skills, and using assessment results to improve teaching and learning outcomes.

Current industry experience in culinary arts, baking and pastry, hospitality, foodservice, catering, or a related field that supports workforce-relevant instruction that spans local/regional/international cuisine.

Proficiency in using the Canvas Learning Management System (LMS) for course management, communication, grading, assessment, student engagement and demonstrated use of effective instructional practices, including hands-on learning, active learning strategies, and technology-enhanced teaching methods.
Demonstrate strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, collaborate effectively with students, faculty, staff, and industry partners.
